card: Yes/No सवाल सहायक क्रिया (is, are, does, did, will, can, has) से शुरू होता है: Was he playing cricket? Wh-सवाल: सवाल शब्द + सहायक + कर्ता + क्रिया: Where do you live?
Yes/No sawaal sahaayak kriya (is, are, does, did, will, can, has) se shuru hota hai: Was he playing cricket? Wh-sawaal: sawaal shabd + sahaayak + karta + kriya: Where do you live?
A Yes/No question begins with a helping verb: Was he playing cricket? A Wh-question: question word + helping verb + subject + verb: Where do you live?

title: सीखो (C, D): नकारात्मक और प्रश्नवाचक
Seekho (C, D): nakaaraatmak aur prashnavaachak
Let's Learn (C, D): negative and interrogative

card: नकारात्मक वाक्य में not सहायक क्रिया के बाद आता है: They are not coming। छोटा रूप: doesn't, didn't, weren't, wasn't, isn't, don't, haven't।
Nakaaraatmak vaakya mein not sahaayak kriya ke baad aata hai: They are not coming. Chhota roop: doesn't, didn't, weren't, wasn't, isn't, don't, haven't.
In a negative sentence, not comes after the helping verb: They are not coming. Short forms: doesn't, didn't, weren't, wasn't, isn't, don't, haven't.

title: चलो बात करें: अशोक और राजू

card: किताब: यह बातचीत नाटक की तरह करो। Tinku अशोक बनेगा, तुम राजू बनो।

meaning: हाँ, बहुत। एक चित्रकार को प्रशासक बना दिया गया।

turns.tinku: Yes, it is really a funny thing.
meaning: हाँ, यह सच में मज़ेदार बात है।

replies.say: But Tenali Raman was a very intelligent person.
meaning: पर तेनाली रामन बहुत समझदार थे।
Par Tenali Raman bahut samajhdaar the.

meaning: वे सच में प्रतिभाशाली थे। सिर्फ़ वही राजा से मुख्यमंत्री की शिकायत कर सकते थे।

replies.say: So Tenali Raman appointed a carpenter as a cook.
meaning: तो तेनाली रामन ने एक बढ़ई को रसोइया बना दिया।
To Tenali Raman ne ek badhai ko rasoiya bana diya.

turns.tinku: The king understood the problem at once.
meaning: राजा तुरंत समस्या समझ गए।

meaning: तो यह बहुत अच्छा पाठ है, है ना?

title: चलो पढ़ें: पंक्चर ठीक करने का फ़्लो चार्ट
